title: $DEC0DE — Atari ST deprotection
notes: C tool removes documented protection schemes from ST programs, including Rob Northen Copylock series 1/2, Anti-bitos and several packers. Source and prebuilt binaries for ST and hosts are provided; each supported protection is listed in the README.

title: 15 Second Format

notes: Dave McMurtrie disassembled a historical C64/1541 fast-format utility; 64tass source separates host and drive code. The README names a historical PRG and assembly command, without claiming byte-identical output or a verified run.

title: 2.5vibe128
notes: Standalone native Commodore 128 VIC-IIe 2.5D SDK derived solely from the 3Dvibe64 2.5D pipeline, not its polygon engine. Python builder, native assembly, border FAST acceleration, bitmap/double buffering and four original/optimized automatic/interactive demos. Assembly guide describes 6502-compatible instructions; exact native CPU variant merits follow-up. Upstream documents VICE x128 testing; physical hardware has not been tested. Code/data are PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0.

title: 2.5vibeVic
notes: Standalone native VIC-20 DDA raycaster derived from the qualified 3Dvibe64 raycast-stock experiment, not its polygon engine. Python builder, 6502 assembly runtime, maps and four generated demo PRGs cover monochrome and multicolor character-glyph framebuffers. Requires 24 KB RAM expansion in blocks 1/2/3; unexpanded VIC-20 is unsupported. Upstream reports VICE xvic measurements; real hardware has not been tested. Code/data are PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0.

title: 3D Cube
notes: Author disassembled surviving VIC-20 and C64 PRGs of a historical personal 3D cube demo and recast them as modifiable Kick Assembler projects. Both computer builds and running instructions are documented; provenance is recovered own binary, not an original source archive.

title: 3D Deathchase
notes: Disassembly and annotation of the 1983 ZX Spectrum game Deathchase by Ritchie Swann.

title: 3Dvibe64
notes: Source SDK for eight C64 graphics modes: polygon rendering and a distinct Mode 8 2.5D DDA bitmap renderer. PowerShell/Python scene builder emits 6510/6502 assembly for 64tass; example JSON and guides are included. Mode 8 has no wall UV textures or room-over-room, and is not the historical character-cell renderer. Upstream qualifies stock VICE x64sc; real hardware has not been tested. Code/data are PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. The repository documents Codex-assisted use of the SDK, not independently verified AI authorship of the engine.

title: 6502 Integer Multiplication

title: a2-hires-lab
display_title: a2-hires-lab — Apple II Lode Runner graphics workbench
source_language: Apple II Lode Runner 6502 disassembly and sprite tables
notes: Excel/VBA workbench exploring the original Apple II Lode Runner sprite bytes, two-stage shift tables and HGR memory/NTSC color behavior using data from XekriRedmane's disassembly. The author quantifies a possible direct-table optimization; this is an analysis experiment, not a patch to the original game. VBA source is exported in src/bas. README documents Windows Excel 365/2024 and manual workbook checks; Python shift-table tests exist. HISTORY explicitly describes LLM sessions and corrected Gemini-authored assembly explanations. The author's separate a2-lode-runner work is already tracked; this workbook is distinct.

runtime_profiles.notes: Excel for Microsoft 365 or Excel 2024 with macros enabled; web Excel cannot run VBA. Author tested on Windows 11.

title: a2scsi-rom
display_title: Apple II SCSI Card ROM — annotated disassembly
notes: Commented disassembly of Apple II SCSI Card ROM revision 341-0437-A (rev. c), with sixteen 1 KiB banks and SourceGen project files. Its Makefile reassembles the complete ROM for EPROM programming or MAME; the README also documents driver interactions and firmware behavior. Byte-exact output is not asserted.
